nom: Drunk Elephant Pekee Face Cleansing Bar

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or T-zone-prone skin report the bar controls shine through the day and helps stop pores clogging, though one found it insufficient against acne when used only once daily.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some describing worsening dryness with age, report the bar cleans without stripping or leaving tightness, calling it a rare bar soap that doesn't dry the face.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe balanced, non-drying results, smaller-looking pores and clearer skin, with one noting the bar alone doesn't remove makeup so a pre-cleanse is still needed.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with rosacea or eczema, report years of daily use with no irritation or breakouts, but one reviewer with sensitive skin had itching on the body and discontinued use, and another suspected a reaction after a possible formula change.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their mature years (including one nearly 70) describe the bar as gentle, non-drying and a long-standing staple in their routine, with one noting reduced smile lines.

concerns.aging: A few mature or older reviewers note smoother skin and reduced smile lines over weeks of use; no reviewer reports the product worsening signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe the bar as non-drying and moisturizing even for very dry skin, but two reviewers report increased dryness or tightness requiring extra moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea report calm, non-inflamed skin with continued use, and no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the bar as low-pH and non-stripping, protecting the skin barrier even with daily or twice-daily use; no barrier complaints appear.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report clearer skin, fewer blackheads and clogged pores easing over weeks of use; no dissent is recorded for this concern.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report significant reduction in breakouts and cystic acne over weeks to months, but one reviewer and her daughter broke out badly after a month of use, and another with acne says it did not help.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the bar keeps their face matte and oil-free through the day, though one reviewer needed to add a second daily wash to fully control an oily T-zone.

aspects.libelle: Creamy, low lather that rinses clean
No dedicated soap dish or storage included
Doesn't remove makeup or sunscreen alone
High price point for a bar soap

extraits.texte: Did not work for me or my daughter. We broke out terribly and gave it over a month. It does work very well for my friend.

extraits.titre: Awesome cleanser, great for sensitive/combination skin
extraits.texte: This cleanser has been a saving grace for me. I have sensitive/combination skin, and this stuff has been a part of my regimen for a while. It lasts, doesn't dry me out and I dont break out. I'm starting to go through the change...and I think it's going to go through it with me as my skin is more balanced now and not as oily as it was when I was younger. Been using this for a few years now.

Purchased because it was 90% off at my local store's clearance section. Was skeptical to use this since my face is very sensitive and DRY. I have patches of discoloration from a pretty bad episode of rosacea. I used this as a second cleanser in the shower for my face, neck, and chest after using my oil based cleanser just to be sure my skin wasnt left too dry(oil breaks out my neck, chest and back, but my face needs an added boost and its best for removing makeup). Followed through with the glass skin serum from peach slices and then the drunk elephant marula oil before it dried to lock in the moisture. Works like a charm. Sensitive skin approved. Not sure what the other comments were complaining about but I guess everyone has different allergies in the end. This cleanser is Creamy, rinsed off sooo so good you can tell its a high quality bar soap. No scent either, I was kind of bummed out about that but I understand it is a lot safer that way. Noticable difference in my smile lines after using for about 2 weeks. Never realized how long bar soaps last over liquids until now. Id recommed if you have daughters that are getting into skin care to try it out or add it to a gift set. Totally harmless!

After starting my DE morning and night routine, I found that my pores were clogging up and my skin was breaking out with a few pimples and whiteheads without a soap to use daily when I wake up (sorry, DE, when you have an oily face, you DEFINITELY have to wash your face at least once a day‚ÄîI gave it the good ole college try, and it didn‚Äôt work for me). No problem, though! I tried a sample of the Beste No. 9 Jelly that I got from a previous purchase and just felt I needed something more. After reading up on the Pekee Bar, I decided to give it a go. It‚Äôs definitely what I need for my t-zone and my nose in the morning before my routine. My pores aren‚Äôt clogging anymore, and it doesn‚Äôt dry my face out! Will keep buying! :smiley:

extraits.titre: Most amazing little bar that ever did exist!
extraits.texte: Let me tell you, I have been struggling with acne and oily skin my whole life. I‚Äôve been using this for the past 8 months and my skin has improved tremendously. Top it off with pro-Tini and b-hydra and night and skip the wash (just water) in the morning! Amazing!!!!

extraits.titre: It is a great cleansing bar
extraits.texte: Using it to wash my face and I really like it, leaves my skin clean but not dried out. I have very dry, very sensitive skin. It is pricey, but it will last a loooong time as a facial cleanser (if not left in a soap dish where it will disolve in water or in a place where family members would use it as general soap)

I have rosacea and prefer a "bar" over a liquid cleanser. There is something about lathering a bar between your hands that I like. I did a lot of research and decided to try the Pekee bar. I am glad I did as it truly is calming and gentle. I have not had any issues with my rosacea being inflamed. I have the travel bar also so I am never without. Try it Drunk Elephant Pekee Bar and you won't be disappointed.
